name: Higashikawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Higashikawa town emblem in white: an outlined five-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Higashikawa, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Higashikawa town emblem — an outlined five-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character
